notes: Open is treated as on and closed as off. Eight complete open-close episodes are visible. The passage door into the bedroom is opened near frame 1480 but remains open in the supplied sequence, so no unsupported off transition was assigned to it.
scene_description: A first-person fisheye traversal of an apartment kitchen, living area, utility spaces, and bedroom. The user deliberately opens and later closes appliance doors, a drawer, cabinet doors, and several closets.
